title: Inside the “Black Box” of Private Merger Negotiations
use: establishes SEC merger filings as a scalable retrospective process-tracing source; 1,324 completed acquisitions hand-collected from 1994–2016
limitations: sample contains completed public-company acquisitions; filings are retrospective, legally curated, and omit much private context

title: LinkedIn definitive proxy statement (Background of the Merger)
use: full historical trace of proposals, exclusivity, board and committee authority, draft terms, refusals, approval and signature
limitations: retrospective narrative prepared for stockholder/legal disclosure; does not expose full private worlds or rejected micro-options

title: Microsoft to acquire LinkedIn
use: announcement-only ablation source
limitations: reports the selected final relation, not the formation process or rejected terms

title: Microsoft Form 8-K reporting completion of LinkedIn acquisition
use: target-world closing/effect witness
limitations: confirms legal completion, not long-term acceptance or value

title: iRobot definitive proxy statement for amended Amazon merger
use: financing need, Amazon consent, price amendment, board authority, exit and antitrust fee terms
limitations: retrospective and transaction-focused; private regulator and company reasoning only partially visible

title: Amazon and iRobot sign an agreement for Amazon to acquire iRobot
use: announcement-only ablation source for initial deal
limitations: selected terms only

title: Amazon and iRobot Modify Merger Price
use: announcement-only ablation source for amended price and financing
limitations: does not expose consent topology, alternatives, or full termination logic

title: European Commission preliminary view on Amazon/iRobot
use: external regulator objection/Defeater
limitations: preliminary public view, not the full confidential case file

title: Amazon and iRobot agree to terminate pending acquisition
use: public termination disposition
limitations: does not provide complete regulator or internal counterfactual record

title: iRobot 2024 Form 10-K
use: termination fee, debt repayment, leadership and restructuring follow-up
limitations: cannot identify the causal share of the failed merger versus declining sales and other conditions

title: Blue Origin Federation, LLC; Dynetics, Inc.-A Leidos Company
use: fixed-schema negative case; reserved contingencies, authorized negotiations, evidence admissibility and protest adjudication
limitations: public version redacts protected information and reconstructs a dispute record rather than private participant experience

title: As Artemis Moves Forward, NASA Picks SpaceX to Land Next Americans on Moon
use: announcement-only ablation source and award assertion
limitations: does not expose funding negotiation, evidence-admissibility rules, or protest reasoning

title: CaSiNo: A Corpus of Campsite Negotiation Dialogues for Automatic Negotiation Systems
use: hidden preferences, reasons, persuasion, rapport and NoDeal in 1,030 human-human dialogues
limitations: authors explicitly describe it as a tractable closed-domain abstraction; preferences are assigned and institutional rules fixed

title: Deal or No Deal? End-to-End Learning for Negotiation Dialogues
use: private utility, independent agreement readback, disagreement and NoDeal across 5,808 human dialogues
limitations: item types, actions, reward function and 10-turn termination are fully pre-specified; no real authority or external effect

title: Decoupling Strategy and Generation in Negotiation Dialogues
use: real listings, price bargaining, free-form language and side offers across 6,682 human-human dialogues
limitations: buyer/seller roles, listing object, core action and utility are still mostly fixed by the experimental platform

title: ML System Development Processes Expert Interview Transcripts
use: open interview transcripts and process descriptions for organizational context and role/process vocabulary
limitations: self-report reconstruction, small regional sample, not a complete event trace, commitment record or effect witness; raw zip was rate-limited during this pass

title: Developing Machine Learning Systems: Situational Factors Shaping the Development Process
use: documents nine expert interviews, process variants, POC/feasibility and expert-knowledge reconstruction limits
limitations: small sample and self-report; does not identify full authority topology or actual contractual outcomes

title: The Method of Structured, Focused Comparison
methods: Standardized questions asked across theoretically selected cases.
limitations: Method guide, not case evidence.
use: Cross-case comparison design.

title: Understanding Process Tracing
methods: Temporal examination of diagnostic causal-process observations and competing explanations.
limitations: Does not make archival evidence experimental.
use: Chronology-preserving within-case analysis.

title: Conducting secondary analysis of qualitative data: Should we, can we, and how?
methods: Critical interpretive synthesis of qualitative secondary analysis practice.
limitations: General method review.
use: Defines epistemic and contextual limits of reusing archived qualitative data.

title: What Makes a Good Response? An Empirical Analysis of Quality in Qualitative Interviews
authors: Jonathan Ivey; Anjalie Field; Ziang Xiao
methods: 343 interviews, 16,940 participant responses, 14 deposited research projects; 2,400 human annotations on a validation subset.
limitations: Preprint; corpus harmonization may lose original project context.
use: Source discovery and interview-corpus quality guidance.

title: Waterfront Toronto Public Consultation on the draft MIDP: Round One Feedback Report
methods: Four public meetings, online consultation, written submissions, library drop-ins; appendices preserve extensive feedback.
limitations: Summarized by project authority; not all private negotiations visible.
use: Standing, public objections, data/governance and scope challenges.

title: Threshold Issues Resolution Documents
methods: Documented resolution of threshold scope, governance, privacy, land and commercial issues.
limitations: Records agreed terms, not complete bargaining transcript.
use: Material schema revision and authority reallocation.

title: DSAP Supplemental Report on the Sidewalk Labs Digital Innovation Appendix
methods: Expert panel review and written commentary; explicitly partial and non-consensus.
limitations: No claim that silence means acceptance; panel time constrained.
use: Independent challenge, unresolved data governance and public-sector authority.

title: Plan Development Agreement amendments and termination notice
methods: Executed agreement text, amendments, termination clauses and notice.
limitations: Does not establish causal motive beyond stated/recorded basis.
use: Formal authority, approval, exit and survival semantics.

title: Waterfront Toronto Integrated Annual Report 2019–2020
methods: Annual institutional report summarizing consultation, withdrawal and retained learning.
limitations: Institutional self-report; economic/COVID attribution must not be converted into governance causality.
use: Outcome attribution and termination boundary.

title: Operational Governance – Open Banking Rules and Guidelines
methods: Formal roles, registration, standards, service levels, complaints, disputes, breach, suspension and exclusion rules.
limitations: Design document; does not prove enacted governance quality.
use: Institutional compilation and runtime governance.

title: Update on Open Banking
methods: Summary of an independent investigation covering corporate governance, conflicts, procurement/value, accounts and HR.
limitations: Summary rather than full underlying evidence.
use: Governance failure as reopen trigger.

title: Open Banking Lessons Learned Review
authors: Kirstin Baker / Competition and Markets Authority
methods: Meetings with current/former CMA staff and board, inquiry group, CMA9, OBIE trustees/board and other stakeholders, plus document review.
limitations: Institutional learning review, not causal experiment.
use: Technical success/governance failure separation; review gates and lifecycle oversight.

title: Recommendations for the next phase of open banking in the UK
methods: Regulatory recommendations and transition design for long-term framework.
limitations: Prospective design, not completed outcome at publication.
use: Reallocation of long-term authority and institutionalization.

title: Retail banking market investigation case page
methods: Chronological repository of roadmap decisions and oversight letters.
limitations: Index/timeline, not analytic evidence.
use: Roadmap completion and continuing oversight chronology.

title: Crossrail System Integration Management Plan
methods: Formal plan covering integration authority, review points, requirements, verification, interfaces, configuration and assurance.
limitations: Plan existence does not prove implementation or effectiveness.
use: Designed schema versus enacted integration.

title: Completing Crossrail
methods: Document analysis and interviews with sponsors, delivery organization and stakeholders.
limitations: Retrospective audit after major delay.
use: Interface risk, aspirational planning, cost/effect gaps.

title: Independent review of Crossrail – Governance
publisher: Transport for London / Department for Transport
methods: Independent governance review using documentary and stakeholder evidence; public version redacted.
limitations: Redactions and commissioning context.
use: Decision rights, transparency, assurance and governance reset.

title: Sponsoring a Major Project: The Crossrail Experience
authors: Department for Transport; Infrastructure and Projects Authority
methods: 90+ Chatham House interviews, short surveys, three workshops, internal/external scrutiny and peer review.
limitations: Confidential interviews unavailable for independent transcript recoding.
use: Lifecycle governance, integration accountability, assurance, incentives and control gates.

title: The Sustainable Groundwater Management Act Governance Conference: Research and Practice — Synthesis Report
methods: Conference synthesis across researchers/practitioners; reports interviews, observation, institutional coding and case studies.
limitations: Synthesis contains heterogeneous substudies and some early-stage findings.
use: Institutional variety, standing/representation, multi-level governance and data sharing.

title: The relationship between how agencies work together and coordinated outcomes: a configurational analysis
publisher: Journal of Public Administration Research and Theory
methods: Ethnographic data from 2018–2022 and multi-value QCA across 18 groundwater basins.
limitations: Published analysis; full article may require purchase; causal scope is configurational, not experimental.
use: Collaborative institutional arrangements and coordinated outcomes.

title: Not Whether to Coordinate, But How: Concerns and Mechanism Choice Under a Mandate for Inter-Agency Coordination
authors: Anita Milman; Michael Roberts; Amber Walsh; William Blomquist
publisher: Perspectives on Public Management and Governance
methods: Empirical study of SGMA coordination mechanism choice under top-down mandate.
limitations: Published analysis does not expose all underlying coding decisions.
use: Autonomy concerns and contingency of mechanism choice.

title: Ascertaining Intergovernmental Coordination Mechanisms
methods: Dataset description reports 52 de-identified interview transcripts; 43 interviews included in the harmonized Qualitative Interview Corpus.
limitations: Direct download was not available in this runtime; no transcript-level claims are made in v0.6.
use: Highest-value next transcript-level calibration source.

title: The Qualitative Interview Corpus
authors: Jonathan Ivey; Anjalie Field; Ziang Xiao
methods: 343 interviews from 14 open de-identified projects, including 43 intergovernmental coordination interviews.
limitations: Harmonization and extraction may remove some original context; direct download unavailable in this runtime.
use: Future transcript-level coding and interviewer-instrument research.

title: LinkedIn Preliminary Proxy Statement (Background of the Merger)
methods: Board-approved disclosure of transaction background, alternatives, bids, authority process, terms and risks.
limitations: Legally curated disclosure; private motives and conversations are selectively summarized.
use: Mature institutional frame and CollapseSafe negative comparator.

title: Microsoft Form 8-K — Completion of LinkedIn acquisition
methods: Formal notice of closing and conversion of shares under the merger agreement.
limitations: Does not evaluate long-run integration value or stakeholder acceptance.
use: Target-world Effect evidence.

title: Microsoft to acquire LinkedIn
methods: Joint announcement of definitive agreement, price, management and independence commitments.
limitations: Promotional party statement; weaker than SEC filing for contested facts.
use: Public commitment terms.

title: Transferring, Translating, and Transforming: An Integrative Framework for Managing Knowledge Across Boundaries
methods: Framework of syntactic, semantic and pragmatic boundaries illustrated through collaborative engineering.
limitations: Not a theory of agent authority or protocol materialization.
use: Positions relation formation beyond information transfer.

title: Life in the Trading Zone: Structuring Coordination Across Boundaries in Postbureaucratic Organizations
authors: Katherine C. Kellogg; Wanda J. Orlikowski; JoAnne Yates
methods: Empirical study of cross-boundary coordination practices under speed and uncertainty.
limitations: Intra-organizational/postbureaucratic setting, not full sovereign authority.
use: Visibility, legibility, revision/alignment and coordination pathologies.

title: Maneuvering in poor visibility: How firms play the ecosystem game when uncertainty is high
authors: Brice Dattée; Oliver Alexy; Erkko Autio
methods: Inductive study of two organizations creating four nascent ecosystems around generative technologies.
limitations: Focal-firm ecosystem orchestration, not neutral multi-principal formation.
use: Value propositions not known ex ante; coupled feedback and dynamic control.

title: Retail Banking Market Investigation Order 2017
use: Formal mandate, implementation entity, trustee authority, approval and variation powers.
limitations: Creates the institutional frame; does not prove governance quality in operation.

title: Open Banking Roadmap substantially complete
use: Technical roadmap completion and continuing obligations.
limitations: Does not establish that long-term governance and consumer representation were complete.

title: Elizabeth line opens to passengers
use: Target-world operational effect witness.
limitations: Opening does not establish that earlier governance design was optimal.

title: Sustainable Groundwater Management Act official implementation overview
use: Official institutional mandate, local GSA structure and state oversight.
limitations: Program overview is not a process-level evaluation.
